The U.S. government on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) announced a tariff of 25% on goods imported from India in response to India’s “unreasonable acts, policies, and practices” that “burden or restrict U.S. commerce”. This is the second-highest tariff among the 14 economies against which the latest action has been taken, second only to the 35% tariff levied on Vietnam.
The Election Commission of India on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) directed that any incorrect or erroneous entries flagged in the electoral rolls during the ongoing Special Summary Revision (SSR) would be corrected using Form 8 after comparing the entries with the corresponding information collected during the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
The Supreme Court on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) orally observed that students who have already opted for three languages for the current academic year may continue with that option , and need not compulsorily switch back to two languages.
Actor Prakash Raj will join the Cockroach Janata Party’s ‘Save Democracy, Save Constitution’ rally in Nagpur on Thursday (November 26, 2026). CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke announced this at a press conference in Nagpur on Wednesday (November 25). He was accompanied by CJP‘s co-convenor Ashutosh Ranka and Ajinkya Shinde. “This public meeting is important because the democratic institutions in this country are being stifled. Vote theft has started happening in every State,” Abhijeet Dipke said, adding that the Gokul election showed how the BJP did not want to lose even a local milk federation election.
The Centre of Indian Trade Unions (CITU) has announced a march of one lakh workers to Parliament on December 1 to demand a universal pension of ₹21,000, a minimum wage of ₹42,000 and a tax on super-rich families, among other things. Economist Jayati Ghosh, who addressed a press conference in New Delhi on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) along with CITU leaders, supported the proposed march and said the country is at the point of an “inequality emergency,” and the workers’ march will be a historic occasion.
Representatives of tech giant Meta met Congress functionaries , including the head of the party’s social media department, amid protests by the Indian Youth Congress (IYC) over alleged bias in content moderation and the suspension of Instagram accounts .Neither side has made any official comment on the meeting that took place on Tuesday (November 24, 2026).
Days after the killing of the last local Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) recruit in Kashmir, the Jammu and Kashmir Police on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) shifted their focus to locals operating from Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK) and attached the properties belonging to seven such individuals.
After its decisive victory in the last week’s Panchayati Raj elections, the Opposition Congress in Rajasthan on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) took control of 24 of the 37 zila parishads which elected their heads, while the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party secured 10 Zila Pramukh posts despite having a majority in just five rural district bodies.
A crash involving a fuel tanker ignited a massive fire on a major highway surrounding Cairo on Wednesday (November 25, 2026), killing at least 30 people, Egyptian authorities said.
Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of the 1980s English new wave band Duran Duran , whose huge pop hits include “Hungry Like the Wolf,” “The Reflex” and “Rio” and whose rise up the charts was inextricably linked to the launch of MTV, has died. He was 65.
It was London in Geneva on Wednesday (November 25, 2026), a day after Berlin in Geneva. If the first game of the World Chess Championship featuring the Berlin Defence opening ended in a draw by a repetition of moves on Tuesday (November 24), it was a similar story in the second game : the London System battle was also drawn by repetition.
